cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll finish this wedding bouquet neatly. Could you pinch the stems while I settle the ribbon?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ribbon will slip. You need wire underneath it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly the adjustment I wanted. You know the grip already; could you twist this wire round while I keep the ribbon clear?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done, but the sharp end will catch the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. Tuck that end in, then wind the ribbon over it; one small bow should finish it. You choose the knot and I'll hold the scissors out of your way.

reason: Make A rebrand B expertise as A intended adjustment, yielding grip/knot choices while tiny favors transfer wire, wrapping and bow to B.
